title: Airborne and Special Operations Museum

services.name: Private Event Requests
services.desc: From military ceremonies and professional receptions to private celebrations, the U.S. Army Airborne & Special Operations Museum offers a setting unlike any other in Fayetteville. Welcome guests into a space defined by dramatic architecture, Airborne history, and a powerful sense of place. The Museum offers indoor and outdoor settings for ceremonies, receptions, meetings, and meaningful celebrations. Each space offers a different way to gather within the Museum’s distinctive architecture and grounds. Sixteen large round columns and five-story glass walls frame the lobby, with a fully deployed parachute and paratrooper behind a brushed aluminum rail at its center and a second parachute

blurb: Established in August 2000, the U.S. Army Airborne & Special Operations Museum is more than a museum-it’s the nation’s premier destination for Airborne and Special Operations history. From the paratroopers of 1940 to the warriors of tomorrow, we capture and share the legacy of courage, skill, and sacrifice that defines these elite forces.
